title: Cost after fixing the verification seed
statement: Let $n,r$ be natural numbers, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over the field with two elements, let the seed map each length-$r$ Boolean bit vector to a vector in that field’s $n$-dimensional cube, and fix such a bit vector. For any Boolean target, the verification program that evaluates the seeded matrix-product verification predicate has deterministic output equal to that verification result and cost $(0,0,6n^2+4n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: three n by n matrices over the field with two elements
seed map from length-r Boolean vectors to the n-dimensional vector space over that field
Boolean target function on the n-dimensional sign cube
